verdict.rationale: Mollie's own Subscriptions API automatically creates recurring payments at a developer-specified interval. These are built on recurring payments where the customer completes checkout only once, and the docs warn that subscription retries can cause double charges without an idempotency key. That covers the core recurring-billing element of the story, but nothing in the evidence shows plan objects, trial periods, upgrade/downgrade flows, or proration. Missing for 10: plan/price catalog management, free-trial support, subscription upgrades/downgrades, proration logic, independent corroboration.
